events.title: HUMAN MADE
events.summary: In light of all the generative AI games being featured in this October Steam Next Fest, we would like to take the opportunity to reassure players that DESKRAGE has never and WILL never use generative AI.If we want to make my game look like slop, we would rather do it by hand, like real humans!!! Generative AI is destroying not only our planet but our humanity!!!Please go and support all the other indie developers who have put their heart, soul and HUMAN EXPEREINCE into their games

events.title: New Level & More
events.summary: Hello all, We have been hard at work on Build A Bot and I’d like to introduce some of the new content in our upcoming demo update :DNew Level In this update we are introducing the capital city “New Unity” :D Battle through the streets of the New Unity as it is in a military takeover by Mega-Corp. This level will sport large play areas, which is a good starting point for newer players!Mini BossesEach level in Build A Bot will have a unique level boss AND a mini boss!!!
